responsibility: This file implements a small GIMPLE pass that finalizes alignment for automatic local declarations in a function. It walks local decls, ignores globals and hard-register variables, reads target- or frontend-computed LOCAL_DECL_ALIGNMENT values, checks that alignment only increases, and writes the result back to DECL_ALIGN. Its role is to apply per-local stack/object alignment decisions before later lowering and backend stages consume the decl metadata.
